name: proto-blocks/cadco-product-specs
title: Cadco Product Specifications
description: A tinted band carrying the product's specifications, grouped under labelled tags, its feature list, a warranty note and the buttons for its spec sheet and manual. Read from the product being viewed, so it is placed once in the single product template.

warrantyText.label: Warranty note
warrantyText.default: 3 Year Warranty on ALL Bakerlux Convection Ovens
warrantyText.help: The same note for every product. A per-product warranty would belong on the product, not here.

warrantyLink.label: Warranty note links to
warrantyLink.help: Optional. A path or URL — e.g. /support/warranty-info/ — which turns the note into a link.

showDownloads.label: Show the download buttons
showDownloads.help: The product's spec sheet and manual, taken from the resources tagged to it. Each button is left out when there is no such resource.
